environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443→8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No application-layer inspection. Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with default permissions.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP listener (no HTTP inspection)
